metadata.description: Small Claude Code tools and skills by Mark Henry.

plugins.name: quota
plugins.description: Weekly quota left on Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions behind CLIProxyAPI vs an even-spend target, plus automatic account-weight rebalancing.

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Download and clip videos with yt-dlp and ffmpeg, including past windows of streams that are still live.

plugins.name: flights
plugins.description: Scrape the Google Flights price calendar (cheapest fare per day across months) via browser-use.

plugins.name: sleep
plugins.description: Infer last night's bedtime and wake time from the Mac lid log, cross-checked against Chrome history.

plugins.name: gordian
plugins.description: Big-picture simplification audit for code that has accumulated complexity from many small edits.

plugins.name: figure
plugins.description: Turn a result into a self-contained figure: the claim as title, a qualifying caption, then the chart.

plugins.name: naming
plugins.description: Choose a name that travels: state its job, list the siblings it must not be confused with, brainstorm widely, test candidates against the classic rules, recommend one.

plugins.name: amazon
plugins.description: Read the Amazon Cart (with same-day windowed items flagged), Amazon Fresh Cart and Whole Foods Market Cart from a dedicated agent Chrome; hand items to your real Chrome to add.

plugins.name: evals
plugins.description: LLM eval hygiene: judge (build and validate an LLM judge: Hamel Husain's evals-skills procedure plus house rules, TPR/TNR on a held-out split), audit (a subagent reads a stratified high/middle/low sample of scored items and flags scores too high, too low or broken, before a human looks) and shadow (tune a new prompt-driven component live, one case at a time: sealed prediction, run, blind human verdict scored against the agent's sealed bet, log, change the prompt on patterns).

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Reach a decision with fresh agents, or with the user. draftoff: three drafts of a document on different organizing ideas, grafted, then picked blind against a plain default draft. docket: present the user one decision at a time, each with the context needed to decide.

plugins.name: check
plugins.description: Can this be trusted? attack: a fresh agent that has not seen your reasoning finds what is wrong with a plan, a brief or finished work. One or two blind readers run what can be run and paste the evidence under each finding; you label every finding.

plugins.name: unattended
plugins.description: Run work unattended and trust the result. brief: interview the user until they have decided what they want, then freeze it as a written brief an unattended run can build against. go: carry a frozen brief to a checked result inside the approved cap, with proof of done and the user's decisions last. arbiter: keep the judge of done out of the worker's reach, with the arbiter-loop script on PATH.

plugins.name: lab
plugins.description: ML-lab rigor. experiment: the one guideline for a single experiment (fine-tune, RL, LLM eval or judge): the order of events, thirteen rules (one recorded difference between arms, prediction first, controls, noise floor, leakage, a validated instrument, the freeze, a script-written run record) each with how to meet it, the preregistration record with its tool, and the sign-off. supervisor: the door to that sign-off, where a fresh agent rules on the design before launch and on the number before it is quoted.

plugins.name: upstream
plugins.description: Send a pull request to a repo someone else owns: read its CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README and contributing guide before writing any commit, check that the PR is wanted, match the project's commit and PR conventions, run its checks, and show the user the draft before opening it.

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Vendored from drivelineresearch/autoresearch-claude-code (MIT): an unattended, measured experiment loop that locks the scorer by hash, measures the noise floor, keeps a change only if it beats the best by more than that floor, and logs every run, with hooks for continuation and compaction.
